      public Consumer<List<ObjectComponent>> getNotifyAction()

    • setNotifyAction

      public void setNotifyAction(Consumer<List<ObjectComponent>> action)
      Notify action is executed every time a Vector3 is updated. By doing this, you can just simply use set(double, double, double), setX(double) etc., and ensure that you will get notified on Vector3 update. To execute action yourself, use: 
       
      myVector3Instance.getNotifyAction().accept(null);
      Or instead of passing null, you can pass the list of ObjectComponent. For example, you can pass the list of excluded components from notify (e.g. to prevent notify of the same component).
      Parameters:
      action - Action to be performed
